_meta.principle: If a flag is false or missing, the pipeline MUST NOT perform that action in this state.
_meta.reload_cadence: monthly, or whenever a state passes new legislation
_meta.gate_logic_precedence: lead_type is checked FIRST. If lead_type == 'b2b_vendor' (title companies, lenders, attorneys, contractors, JV wholesalers, other professionals), the b2b_vendor_outreach_default carve-out applies and consumer-state rules are SKIPPED. If lead_type in {'seller', 'homeowner', 'homeowner_distress'}, the per-state consumer rules apply. Per-state b2b_vendor_outreach_allowed flag can override the default to false on a state-by-state basis if needed.

tn_only_lockdown.note: TN-only lockdown 2026-05-27 per operator Rich: only Tennessee runs autonomous. Triggered by unauthorized GA (555 Stonebriar Way, Atlanta) Onity-lender inquiry that bypassed the gate via b2b carve-out. Other states are BUILD-OUT ONLY until TN proves out + operator greenlight.

b2b_vendor_outreach_default.description: B2B vendor outreach carve-out. Applies when lead_type == b2b_vendor (title companies, lenders, attorneys, contractors, JV wholesalers, other professionals). Professional-to-professional commercial communication, NOT consumer telemarketing, so per-state consumer telemarketing statutes (FTSA, TX SB 140, TN HB 2537, MO No-Call, etc.) do not apply on the same terms.
b2b_vendor_outreach_default.autonomous_bot_call_reason: TCPA prior-express-written-consent applies even to B2B cell phones. Manual human voice only on cold B2B calls.
b2b_vendor_outreach_default.sms_reason: TCPA + state SMS statutes still attach to B2B cell numbers in many jurisdictions. Default to email for cold B2B; SMS only after a prior reply or established relationship.
b2b_vendor_outreach_default.consent_ladder_reason: Consumer protection consent ladders (homeowner distress, foreclosure rescue) do not apply to vendor-to-vendor outreach.
b2b_vendor_outreach_default.federal_dnc_scrub_note: Federal DNC primarily protects residential consumer numbers; published business main lines are generally exempt. Scrub anyway as a courtesy and to catch personal cell numbers misclassified as business.

call_hours_local.reason: Business hours only. B2B outreach outside business hours signals consumer-grade telemarketing and erodes trust.

b2b_vendor_outreach_default.recording_disclosure_reason: All-party-consent state defensive default. If recording any B2B call, open with disclosure regardless of state.
b2b_vendor_outreach_default.per_state_override: If a state block sets b2b_vendor_outreach_allowed: false, this default is REVERSED for that state and B2B outreach is BLOCKED. None set as of 2026-04-25.

outbound_call_hours_local.buffer_reason: TCPA hard limits are 8am-9pm local. Operate 9am-8pm to absorb daylight-saving and timezone edge cases.

OH.autonomous_bot_call_reason: TCPA prior-express-written-consent requirement for autodialed/AI-voice calls. No bot calls cold in OH.
OH.preforeclosure_blocked_reason: ORC 1349.61 foreclosure rescue statute: 5-day rescission, written contract, criminal penalties. NO without attorney wrapper.
OH.marketing_property_without_equitable_int: Ohio HB 132 (2022) restricts advertising property as 'for sale' without ownership or equitable interest. Stay on principal-buyer assignment model.
OH.consumer_sales_practices_act_ref: ORC 1345 (Ohio CSPA): fair-dealing standard governs seller communications.
OH.broker_license_law_ref: ORC 4735 (must hold equitable interest via principal-buyer contract; no marketing properties not under contract).

disclosures.residential_property_disclosure_form_sco: 1-to-4 unit residential, mandatory passthrough from seller to buyer

OH.gate_notes: Cleveland niche. Notice state, not full disclosure, but ORC 5302.30 RPDF is mandatory passthrough on 1-4 unit residential. HB 132 forbids marketing property without equitable interest: stay strictly principal-buyer. ORC 4719 telephone solicitor registration kicks in above 50 OH calls/month, current pipeline volume is exempt. ORC 1349.61 makes any NOD-recorded lead an attorney-only matter.
